correctness_argument:
P1 of the ontology unification (Path U, stage 3): one identifier namespace on GenePerturbation.

WHY IT IS MORE CORRECT. The host genome a record's identifiers are written against is a fact of every gene perturbation, and before this change it was expressible only by choosing a class: 12 leaves (measured by reflection over torchcell.datamodels.schema at main 2fd68995c; the audit's 13 counted BacterialBackgroundAllele, which is not a GenePerturbation) declared gene_namespace, 9 declared the same identifier_mapping, 8 overrode validate_sys_gene_name with the bacterial locus-tag union, and every yeast leaf stated no host at all, so the Carruthers 2025 native phnW/phnX copies were stored on GeneAdditionPerturbation with no host and fell out of the served node lane (review 1, 'what is sound'). The constitution's principles 1, 4 and 5 (ontologize the experiment not the organism; the host is a property of the material and lives on the perturbation; one fact, one field, one closed vocabulary, never a choice of class) are what this change implements: gene_namespace: GeneIdNamespace is REQUIRED on GenePerturbation and means the HOST the record is written against, identifier_mapping moves to the base beside it, and the leaf classes no longer encode a host.

THE MEASURED VOCABULARY. GeneIdNamespace is measured, not assumed (constitution 5): experiments/database/scripts/measure_gene_id_namespaces.py opened all 51 served dev stores of release 2026.10.06-4b293d34 read-only and classified every stored systematic_gene_name (130,685,237 identifiers; results in experiments/database/results/gene_id_namespace_vocabulary.{json,md}). Found: SGD S288C systematic names on every pinned yeast leaf (130,537,788 identifiers, 51 of 51 stores); the Peter 2018 pangenome column ids <n>-<ORF name> on CaudalPanTranscriptome2024Dataset's natural_gene_presence (79,016 identifiers, e.g. 13-EC1118_1N26_0012g); and 68,433 non-host identifiers on relaxed leaves (released gene symbols on released_gene_name, heterologous symbols and construct names on gene_addition, standard names on natural_loss_of_function) that match no host pattern and whose record names the S288C-derived host it was built in. No served store carries a CURIE or a bacterial tag. The registry's deposited sets add the five bacterial locus-tag spaces (100 mapped, 0 served dev stores) and CEN.PK113-7D, whose 6,171 locus tags were measured from the deposited GenBank GCA_002571405.2 (5,865 SCEN_<chromosome><5 digits>, 21 mitochondrial SCEN_Q/SCEN_R, 285 SCEN_<chromosome>trna<n><amino acid>); the S288C pattern matches 7,147 of 7,148 gene-class features of the R64-4-1 GFF (the exception, YNCI0012, carries no strand letter and was never stored). So GeneIdNamespace has eight members: scerevisiae_s288c_sgd_systematic, scerevisiae_cenpk113_7d_locus_tag, scerevisiae_peter2018_pangenome_orf and the five bacterial members, with GENE_ID_NAMESPACE_PATTERNS pairwise disjoint (pinned by test_every_namespace_pattern_is_pairwise_disjoint_from_every_other and test_the_identity_families_do_not_overlap). There is no released, other or mixed member (review 1 finding 2; constitution 5): 'resolved or released' is a property of the identifier and stays a property of the leaf class, and every released leaf keeps the host in gene_namespace. BacterialGeneNamespace and BACTERIAL_LOCUS_TAG_PATTERNS survive unchanged in membership as the bacterial restriction of the general vocabulary (BACTERIAL_LOCUS_TAG_PATTERNS is now derived from GENE_ID_NAMESPACE_PATTERNS, an equivalent refactor) because BacterialBackgroundAllele still reads them; P5 retires both.

VALIDATION. GenePerturbation.validate_sys_gene_name requires the identifier to have the form of SOME member (_validate_host_identifier), and the new base model validator _identifier_agrees_with_namespace requires a host-form identifier to be the DECLARED host's (_check_gene_namespace generalized over every member, with the eck_crosswalk and locus_tag_synonym route checks unchanged). A leaf whose identifiers are legitimately not host identifiers keeps its own validator (the addition family, the Natural* leaves, CopyNumberVariant, NaturalLossOfFunction, the released leaves, SiteVariantCall), so this is _check_gene_namespace generalized, not a pure namespace dispatch replacing the per-class validators (review 1, recommended changes).

THE DEFAULT RULE, MEASURED. gene_namespace defaults to scerevisiae_s288c_sgd_systematic on exactly the leaves whose name validator resolves to GenePerturbation's (the stored name's form already proves the namespace, so the default asserts nothing the record does not say) and on no leaf whose validator is relaxed or host-neutral. By reflection the 14 declarations are DeletionPerturbation (inherited by KanMx, NatMx, BarcodedKanMx, SgaKanMx, SgaNatMx, Mean, Marker and CrisprDeletion), HeterozygousDeletion, ConditionalAllele, Damp (SgaDamp), TsAllele (SgaTs), Allele (SgaAllele), SuppressorAllele (SgaSuppressor), NamedAllele, SequenceVariant, EngineeredCopyNumber, CrisprActivation, CrisprInterference and InduciblePromoterInsertion; the leaves with NO default are GeneAddition, PromoterDrivenGeneIntegration, VariablePromoterReporter, HeterologousPathway, NaturalGeneAbsence, NaturalGenePresence, CopyNumberVariant, NaturalLossOfFunction, ReleasedGeneName, the three BacterialReleased* leaves, and the host-neutral DeletionStrain, SpanDeletionCall, TransposonInsertion, PromoterReplacement, MarkedAllele, Degron, VariantCall, LocusVariantCall and SiteVariantCall (pinned by test_gene_namespace_is_required_on_the_base_and_defaulted_on_pinned_leaves_only). The measurement supports the rule: every pinned-leaf identifier in the 51 served stores is an S288C systematic name, and every served reference strain is S288C-derived (BY4741, BY4742, BY4743, FY4, S288C). Every bacterial call site stays byte-identical (the kwarg already existed); the 27 yeast call sites on relaxed leaves and the 3 in torchcell/sequence/natural_isolate.py now state the host (S288C, or the pangenome member on the accessory-presence leaf), and the Carruthers native copies state KT2440, which closes the defect that motivated the change.

LEAF FATE (owner, 2026-10-15: 'yes rename'). The two leaves that differed from a general leaf by the namespace alone fold into it: BacterialCrisprInterferencePerturbation -> CrisprInterferencePerturbation and BacterialCrisprActivationPerturbation -> CrisprActivationPerturbation (removal; tags bacterial_crispr_interference -> crispr_interference, bacterial_crispr_activation -> crispr_activation). Every leaf that keeps a real material difference is renamed to a general name: BacterialDeletionPerturbation -> DeletionStrainPerturbation (bacterial_deletion -> deletion_strain, deletion_type bacterial -> strain), BacterialMarkedAllelePerturbation -> MarkedAllelePerturbation (marked_allele), BacterialDegronPerturbation -> DegronPerturbation (degron), BacterialVariantPerturbation -> VariantCallPerturbation (abstract), BacterialSequenceVariantPerturbation -> LocusVariantCallPerturbation (locus_variant_call), BacterialSiteVariantPerturbation -> SiteVariantCallPerturbation (site_variant_call), BacterialSpanDeletionPerturbation -> SpanDeletionCallPerturbation (span_deletion_call, deletion_type called_span). TransposonInsertionPerturbation, PromoterReplacementPerturbation and HeterologousPathwayPerturbation keep their names and lose only the per-leaf declarations. The three BacterialReleased* leaves are not renamed (lane E merges them); they lose only their gene_namespace declaration and inherit the base field, whose vocabulary is wider (the three yeast members), which is why the record claims removal on them. BacterialBackgroundAllele is untouched: folding it into BackgroundAllele moves StrainBackground's served contract (6 served closures), which is P5's record. The Keio home is named DeletionStrainPerturbation rather than a cataloged-collection name because the leaf's own loaders were measured: of its 25 constructor sites in torchcell/datasets, 10 state a collection and a cassette (the Keio screens), 2 a collection only, and 13 neither (the designed deletion strains of Choe 2019, Lim 2025, Thompson 2019, de Siqueira 2025, Kang 2026, Carruthers 2025, Menasalvas 2025, Banerjee 2024/2025, Balakrishnan 2022), so 'cataloged' or 'collection' would misstate 13 of 25 sites; the material the leaf states is a deletion STRAIN, the gene's deletion plus the strain-level facts the source states (collection, cassette, construction, each verbatim when stated), the discriminators that make two deletions of one gene two strains, which is what its docstring has always said. It asserts no marker (unlike BarcodedKanMxDeletionPerturbation) and can state one (unlike DeletionPerturbation, #988), so neither is a home for it.

NODE IDS RE-KEY. A perturbation node id is sha256(json.dumps(model_dump())) (torchcell/adapters/cell_adapter.py, _perturbation_node), and the genotype and experiment ids inline the perturbations, so adding gene_namespace and identifier_mapping to GenePerturbation re-keys every perturbation, genotype and experiment node of all 51 served datasets even where the value is the class default; the yeast golden digests in tests/torchcell/adapters/test_bacterial_graph_classes.py moved for every node and edge method except the crispr construct and the phenotype (measured on the branch). Superset admission by content id is therefore impossible across this change: rebuild_scope is full_kg_rebuild as the tool computes it (GenePerturbation is in 50 served closures, GenePerturbationType in 51), the PR carries the schema-breaking label, and the KG 4.0 release note must say content ids are not comparable with 3.0. Every dev store built under a renamed or folded tag is unreadable by aggregate and deduplicate until rebuilt. The pairing is a MINOR package bump, not 2.0.0 (owner, 2026-10-15: 'no major bump minor bump').

ALSO TOUCHED. torchcell/datamodels/__init__.py exports; torchcell/adapters/cell_adapter.py imports and the two lane tuples renamed in place (the tuples now hold the general CRISPR leaves, so the class-keyed lane catches a yeast CRISPRi record: test_a_yeast_record_emits_no_bacterial_perturbation_node and test_the_bacterial_leaf_tuple_is_exactly_the_leaves_carrying_gene_namespace are xfail(strict=True) for lane H, which re-keys the lane); torchcell/verification/runners.py and torchcell/data/experiment_dataset.py keyed on the site-variant tag; the 40 bacterial loaders and the Lim/Menasalvas/Carruthers tag strings; the adapter conf yaml and the graph yaml are untouched (lane H).

alternatives_rejected.alternative: Keep the 14 host-prefixed leaves and let them inherit gene_namespace from the base (the audit's P1 as drafted).
alternatives_rejected.why_rejected: A class would still name a host while the field names one, two assertions of one fact (constitution 5), and the Keio, marked-allele, degron and called-variant leaves would keep a Bacterial prefix for records that are host-neutral by construction (a caller's released call, a cassette at a terminus); the owner ruled 'yes rename' on 2026-10-15, and the two CRISPR leaves differ from the general ones by nothing but the namespace, so they fold rather than rename.

alternatives_rejected.alternative: A released member of GeneIdNamespace for the released leaves (the audit's P1 vocabulary: 5 bacterial + 2 yeast + released).
alternatives_rejected.why_rejected: It erases the host: Nichols 2011 rows are BW25113 records with ECK identifiers and would become 'released' records with no host, and any leaf could declare the member to skip the pattern check, re-opening the escape hatch the two mutually exclusive validators close (review 1 finding 2; constitution 5: one enum that carries two facts is a defect). 'Resolved or released' stays a property of the leaf class; the host stays in the field.

alternatives_rejected.alternative: A pure namespace dispatch: one base validator that checks every identifier against the declared namespace's pattern and replaces every per-class validator.
alternatives_rejected.why_rejected: It refuses what the served stores measurably carry: 68,433 identifiers on relaxed leaves match no host pattern (released symbols, heterologous gene symbols, construct names, standard names on loss-of-function rows) and are correct as stored (the data is the data). The base therefore checks AGREEMENT when the identifier has a host form and leaves admissibility of a non-host form to the leaf, which is _check_gene_namespace generalized (review 1, recommended changes).

alternatives_rejected.alternative: Fold the Keio deletion into BarcodedKanMxDeletionPerturbation or DeletionPerturbation instead of renaming it.
alternatives_rejected.why_rejected: BarcodedKanMxDeletionPerturbation asserts a KanMX cassette and SGA barcodes a Keio FRT-kan-FRT strain does not carry, and DeletionPerturbation (#988) means 'marker not stated'; either fold is a field_meaning change on a served class (review 1 finding 4).

alternatives_rejected.alternative: Name the Keio home CatalogedCollectionDeletionPerturbation or CollectionDeletionPerturbation.
alternatives_rejected.why_rejected: 13 of the leaf's 25 constructor sites in torchcell/datasets state neither a collection nor a cassette (designed deletion strains of the engineered-chassis releases), so a name that asserts a catalog or a collection misstates them; DeletionStrainPerturbation states the material every site shares, a deletion strain with its stated strain-level facts.

alternatives_rejected.alternative: A class default of S288C on every yeast leaf, including the relaxed ones, so no yeast loader changes.
alternatives_rejected.why_rejected: A silent default on a relaxed leaf asserts a host the record did not state (review 1, recommended changes; constitution 7: never default silently); on the pinned leaves the stored name's form proves S288C, on the relaxed leaves nothing does, so those loaders state the host per record, and Caudal's accessory-presence records state the pangenome member.

owner_sign_off.quote: Owner, 2026-10-15, in conversation: 'yes rename, no major bump minor bump. go !'; 'we care most about correctness and are willing right now to do full rebuilds if we identify even small semantically prudent change in onto'; 'like why a bacterial experiment! it seems this is unnecessary distinction.'
